section_summary: This section contains the concluding pages of Tokyo Despatch No. 706 (October 10, 1949) and a transmittal letter from the National Foreign Trade Council (December 21, 1949). Despatch No. 706 covers reactions to the Shoup Mission's tax reform recommendations, including asset revaluation, foreign businessmen's objections to the termination of income tax exemptions, and Japanese government plans under Premier Yoshida to implement tax cuts. The National Foreign Trade Council letter forwards its recommendations evaluating the Shoup Report on Japanese taxation for transmission to SCAP officials.

subfiles.about: Concluding portion of a diplomatic despatch detailing reactions to the Shoup Mission tax reform recommendations and Japanese government plans for tax legislation.
